title: UC model load and register must share one Files-API routing flag
answers: UC model load_model uses vended token and fails on DBR 15.4
register model to Unity Catalog stopped working after tokens blocked
how to route UC model artifacts through Databricks Files API
body:
Symptom: Loading or registering a model in Unity Catalog (models:/catalog.schema.model/version, databricks-uc) fails on DBR 15.4 LTS because UC blocks vended scoped tokens.
Root cause: UnityCatalogModelsArtifactRepository._get_artifact_repo (load) and UcModelRegistryStore._get_artifact_repo (register) each pick the scoped-cloud-credential repo; only the load path was switchable before.
Fix pattern: Both paths check MLFLOW_USE_DATABRICKS_SDK_MODEL_ARTIFACTS_REPO_FOR_UC.get() (read at call time, default False) and return DatabricksSDKModelsArtifactRepository, passing registry_uri (load) or store_uri (register).
Constraints: Change routing in both places together; gating one leaves the other on vended tokens. With the flag unset, behavior must stay identical to the scoped-credential path, which still calls _get_temporary_model_version_write_credentials / _get_scoped_token.
applies: Unity Catalog model registry (databricks-uc) load and register only; not Volumes or DBFS artifact paths.
says: Model loading from the catalog stops working when scoped tokens are blocked on runtime clusters.
Model registration fails because the system continues using legacy tokens instead of the files API.
Support loading and saving catalog models when cloud storage tokens are disabled.
Enabling files routing for catalog models works for loading but fails during registration.
search: Unity Catalog model registry load and register paths must concurrently check MLFLOW_USE_DATABRICKS_SDK_MODEL_ARTIFACTS_REPO_FOR_UC to return DatabricksSDKModelsArtifactRepository. Both UnityCatalogModelsArtifactRepository._get_artifact_repo (passing registry_uri) and UcModelRegistryStore._get_artifact_repo (passing store_uri) must implement this routing to avoid failures when DBR 15.4 LTS blocks vended tokens. This applies strictly to databricks-uc model registry workflows, excluding Volumes or DBFS paths. When unset, the flag defaults to False and preserves legacy calls to _get_temporary_model_version_write_credentials and _get_scoped_token.
